name: Jean-Pierre Dubois
bio:
Jean-Pierre's journey into motorsport began with a childhood obsession with Formula 1, fueled by the legendary battles of Senna and Prost. He earned a degree in Mechanical Engineering from École Polytechnique, specializing in aerodynamics. After graduating, he started his career at a smaller Formula 3 team, quickly making a name for himself with innovative suspension designs. He then moved to Formula 2, where he contributed to several race-winning cars, honing his skills in data analysis and performance optimization. 

His approach to being a chief engineer is highly collaborative, believing that the best results come from fostering a strong team environment where everyone feels empowered to contribute their expertise. Jean-Pierre is known for his meticulous attention to detail and his ability to quickly diagnose and resolve complex mechanical issues, even under immense pressure. His commitment to continuous improvement and his innovative problem-solving skills make him a valuable asset to any racing team. He joined Carlin after they offered him a good promotion and a chance to return to a more familiar and comfortable racing scene.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: A man of average height, with a serious demeanor etched on his face, reflecting years of intense focus and problem-solving.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical sketches and notes.
Has a particular fondness for strong espresso and drinks at least four cups a day.
Tends to tap his pen rhythmically when deep in thought, much to the annoyance of his colleagues.
